geometry: A 158 by 32 rectangle with a dark vertical color gradient and independent horizontal and vertical transparency gradients. The central alpha is approximately 179/255, fading over roughly 7 pixels at each side and 6 pixels at top and bottom.
limitations: Smooth mask gradients approximate source fade; adjusted opacity accounts for renderer compositing. The 8x rendering was inspected.
qt5_compatibility: Rewritten without <mask>, <clipPath> or <filter>, which Qt5's SVG renderer ignores: masked gradient products became 1px strips, clips became hard-stop gradients or even-odd paths, and blur became stacked translucent shapes.
